title: fat_proc_convert_dcm_dwis
description: Convert sets of DWIs in DICOM format into 'nicer' volume+grad format, reorient volumetric data, and glue together multiple sessions/directories of data.

dicom_dir.description: Directory of DICOM files of the DWI data with 'AP' phase encoding. Can contain a wildcard expression for several directories.
dicom_dir.title: Input DICOM Directory

output_prefix.description: Prefix (and path) for output data (e.g., *.nii.gz, *.bvec, *.bval files). Required.
output_prefix.title: Output Prefix

nifti_files.description: One or more NIFTI files of DWIs.
nifti_files.title: NIFTI Files

bvec_files.description: One or more row-wise, gradient (unit-magnitude) files (e.g., *.bvec).
bvec_files.title: bvec Files

work_dir.description: Optional working directory for intermediate files.
work_dir.title: Working Directory

orientation.description: Optional chance to reset orientation of the volume files (default is currently 'RAI').
orientation.title: Orientation

qc_prefix.description: Set the prefix for QC image files separately (default is '').
qc_prefix.title: QC Prefix

reorient_off.description: Turn off reorigin calculation and reorientation.
reorient_off.title: Reorient Off

no_clean.description: Do not remove the working directory of intermediate files (default is to delete it).
no_clean.title: No Clean

no_cmd_out.description: Do not save the command line call and location where it was run.
no_cmd_out.title: No Cmd Out

no_qc_view.description: Do not generate QC image files.
no_qc_view.title: No QC View

do_movie.description: Generate a movie of the newly created dataset (AGIF or MPEG).
do_movie.title: Create Movie
